d.title: Ranma ½: Kessen Tougenkyou! Hanayome wo Torimodose!
d.en: Ranma ½: The Movie 2 - The Battle of Togenkyo: Rescue the Brides!
d.jp: らんま1/2 決戦桃幻郷! 花嫁を奪りもどせ!!
d.synopsis: Ranma and the gang are invited to a boating trip with Kuno. Unfortunately, a storm destroys the yacht and everyone is stranded on a remote island. The whole situation goes even more awry when one by one, the girls disappear without a trace. Ranma then finds out that the girls are abducted by Toma, ruler of the island, as part of his personal harem.
